claimBoundary: This profile qualifies a package-only complete-input baseline JFIF 4:4:4 JPEG slice: 8-bit SOF0, component IDs 1/2/3, 1x1 sampling for all components, one interleaved sequential Huffman scan, 8-bit DQT, optional DRI/RST markers and no DNL/arithmetic coding.

The decoder streams one MCU at a time and retains no frame-sized coefficient surface. It admits tight RGB output plus one fixed 704-byte codec payload backing before allocation: one current coefficient block, one current natural-order quantization table, one ISLOW workspace and three 8x8 Y/Cb/Cr sample blocks.

Generated geometry, content, quality and restart cases must match pinned libjpeg-turbo djpeg -rgb -dct int byte-for-byte. The exact operation charge must succeed and charge-1 must fail before output/scratch allocation.

Passing this profile composes previously exact ISLOW and YCbCr-to-RGB kernels with a three-component interleaved entropy path. It does not qualify subsampled chroma reconstruction, progressive color JPEG, arbitrary component IDs/color transforms or a public production backend.
